requests.model_reasoning: I can see I found a Soft Toy mask covering an object at (223, 217) on the head picture. Measuring from the mask will give dimensions and position for the correct doll, which should remove the ambiguity created by an invalid measurement of the far Soft Toy. This is the immediate step needed before the doll can be grasped and transferred: knowing its full extent and grasp yaw will guide the grasp point and wrist rotation. The wrist image still records that the demonstrated toy is inside the basket, supporting the current evidence for sequence recall, but it is not evidence that all five are placed. The demonstration arm position for the fifth placement has not advanced to the start pose, and the right-side arm is idle without a confirmed reached pose. Therefore, picking the Soft Toy would risk an incorrect or remote doll; the demonstration arm returning home and a new picture have not verified completion of placement; the basket remains in this position and needs a second measurement now that the clasp is gone; and the Soft Toy should be measured only from the mask, and not the object at pixel (223, 217). These checks support waiting for the home result and inspecting the basket, remeasurement, grasp, lift, carry, and release sequence without skipping confirmation. I'll continue moving the learning robot on the fifth step in the sequence by measuring the Soft Toy from the mask and checking reach, not yet moving the robot.
